question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the highlighted group of words in the given sentence.

A grand function was organised to honour the **person who had died for a noble cause**.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Martyr**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Martyr"** means a person who sacrifices their life or suffers greatly for a noble or religious cause. (शहीद)

 
 
• **Example:** Bhagat Singh is remembered as a martyr who gave his life for India's independence.
 
 
 
• **Volunteer** refers to a person who freely offers to take part in an activity or perform a task without being paid. (स्वयंसेवक)
 
 
• **Example:** She works as a volunteer at the local animal shelter.
 
 
 
• Hence, the term **'Martyr'** is most appropriate for someone who has died for a noble cause.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Martyr**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Volunteer** (स्वयंसेवक): A person who freely offers to perform a task or service without being paid.

 
 
• **Example:** The volunteers helped distribute food to the flood victims.
 
 
 
• **Prophet** (भविष्यवक्ता): A person regarded as an inspired teacher or proclaimer of the will of God.
 
 
• **Example:** Muhammad is considered a prophet in Islam.
 
 
 
• **Philanthropist** (परमार्थी): A person who seeks to promote the welfare of others, especially by donating money to good causes.
 
 
• **Example:** The philanthropist donated millions to support education for underprivileged children.
